expected_diagnosis: VM is shut off on hypervisor.
recommended_next_checks: Review event history, scheduled shutdown, storage state.
resolution_guidance: Start only after approval and node health verification.
escalate_when: Repeated unexpected stops or host issue.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
